verdict.rationale: Independent Tom's Hardware and Phoronix benchmarks corroborate the RTX 5090 as the fastest consumer GPU (1.42x over 4090), supporting vendor claims of top-tier gaming performance, and NVIDIA's DLSS/Reflex/path-tracing feature docs target high-refresh 4K use cases. However, community evidence raises real caveats: reviewers flag Founders Edition thermal issues, similar-or-worse perf-per-watt vs 4080/4090, and specifically critique Multi Frame Generation as 'marketing' since input sampling doesn't scale with the reported FPS boost, undercutting the headline frame-rate claims. missing for 10: dedicated 4K high-refresh benchmark suites (e.g. specific FPS-at-4K numbers across many AAA titles), resolution of the MFG input-latency criticism, and confirmation thermal/efficiency issues don't limit sustained high-refresh performance.
